issues.legal_issue: An agreement to lease that expressly creates no interest before execution and registration of the lease does not confer leasehold rights when the lease is never executed.
A purchaser at an auction of a company’s assets acquires only the rights the company held, and the auction does not convey ownership or leasehold rights that the company never possessed.
Funds held in pending liquidation proceedings cannot be directed toward payment of unearned income when competing creditor claims remain unresolved.
The land authority may pursue appropriate proceedings for possession or unearned income and may consider a purchaser’s request to regularise the transaction.
